# Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven

Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven is a regional hospital operating within [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] in Denmark [^src3]. It is one of the healthcare institutions systematically evaluated in the annual reports of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark), which monitors clinical quality and treatment standards across the country [^src2].

In the reporting period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the hospital was assessed on multiple clinical quality indicators. For [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients receiving an echocardiography, Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven achieved a compliance rate of 85.1% (95% CI: 82.1–87.8) [^src2]. 

The hospital also demonstrated strong performance in anticoagulation treatment coverage, measured by [[indikator-4a|Indikator 4a]]. It recorded a treatment rate of 93.0% (95% CI: 89.3–95.7) for patients two years post-diagnosis [^src3]. In a broader analysis of this indicator, the hospital met the national standard and recorded the highest proportion among all evaluated units at 93.6% (95% CI: 90.0–96.2) [^src4]. 

Beyond these primary metrics, the hospital's data appears across various other indicators in the database's comprehensive hospital-level analyses. These include a 96.4% performance rate in one specific metric [^src1], a 93.0% rate in another [^src5], and a 6.2% incidence rate for a specific cardiovascular outcome, such as heart failure following an atrial fibrillation diagnosis [^src6]. Through its continuous participation in these evaluations, Regionshospital Nordjylland Ven contributes to the benchmarking and quality improvement of cardiovascular care in the Danish healthcare system [^src4].
